import csv, os, xlrd
src='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'
outdir='staging'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
s=xlrd.open_workbook(src).sheet_by_index(0)
samples=[str(s.cell_value(1,j)) for j in range(1,s.ncols)]
variables=[str(s.cell_value(i,0)) for i in range(2,s.nrows)]
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'data_matrix.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
 w.writerow(['']+samples)
 for i,var in enumerate(variables,start=2):
  vals=[]
  for j in range(1,s.ncols):
   v=s.cell_value(i,j)
   vals.append('NA' if v=='' else repr(float(v)))
  w.writerow([var]+vals)
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'sample_metadata.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
 w.writerow(['','Group'])
 for sample in samples:
  w.writerow([sample,'Patient' if sample.startswith('P_') else 'Control'])
with open(os.path.join(outdir,'variable_metadata.tsv'),'w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.writer(f,delimiter='\\t',lineterminator='\\n')
 w.writerow(['','miRNA'])
 for var in variables:
  w.writerow([var,var])
print(len(variables),len(samples))
PY"
